svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Anatomy of a chromatogram
svg.desc: A chromatogram plots detector response against time after injection. A small disturbance marks the dead time t0. Peak 1's retention time tR is measured along the time axis from the injection to the top of the peak, and its height from the baseline to the apex. Peak 2 overlaps peak 1 slightly, leaving a valley, and its width is marked at half its height. Peak 3 tails to the right, and its shaded area, which is proportional to the amount of compound, is marked.
